title: Structure-borne sound.
officialText:
Floor/ceiling assemblies between dwelling units or between a dwelling unit and a public or
service area stair, exterior mechanical equipment, or other mechanical equipment space, including boiler rooms, shall be
constructed of assemblies having an impact insulation class (IIC) rating of not less than 50 based upon laboratory measurements
made in accordance with ASTM E 492, or not less than 45 if field tested in accordance with ASTM E 1007 in completed
construction. See Chapter 30 for additional sound control requirements for elevator machinery.
